milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The red sandstone wall is at spawn-relative (5, 0-2, 2-5), so its center is approximately (5, 1, 3). Player must navigate near it and face it to 'find' it. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 ensure the player is looking toward the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange stained glass panes are at spawn-relative (7-8, 0-1, 4). The center of this 2x2 arrangement is approximately (7, 1, 4). Player must navigate near and face the panes to 'find' them. Using facing_tolerance=60 to confirm the player is looking at them.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because glass panes broken without Silk Touch do NOT drop as items (so inventory_has won't work). Instead we verify that at least one magenta glass pane block has been removed from the barrier. The barrier is at spawn-relative (6-8, 0-2, 9) — 9 blocks total. Using a generous box around the barrier and checking at most 8 remain (meaning at least 1 was mined).

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak_button results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player has 2 oak planks in inventory (given via /give) and can craft an oak button (1 plank = 1 button) either at the crafting table or in the 2x2 inventory grid. The oak_button is not in the starting inventory so its presence confirms crafting.
